Stripe to Ziffr: values

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address and which Metric each figure is for, and the currency.
2. Add the credentials: Stripe on the read nodes, and a Header Auth credential named "Ziffr Feed Key" (name Authorization, value Bearer <your Feed Key>) on Send to Ziffr. Make the key in Ziffr under Settings, Feeds, and add the Feed under Who submits on each Metric.
3. Press Execute workflow once to try it, then activate it: it runs on the 1st of every month at 9, for the month that has just ended (UTC).

Your subscriptions, read only: monthly recurring revenue, customers with a subscription and customers who cancelled, for the month that has just ended.
